title: Coaching Institute Forfeiture of Advance Annual Fee
claimant: Sunil Verma (Father of student Rohan Verma)
respondent: Apex Career Institute Pvt. Ltd., Kota
narrative: I enrolled my son Rohan in a 2-year JEE foundation coaching course at Apex Career Institute Kota on July 10, 2024. The institute demanded a full advance annual fee of ₹1,40,000 upfront, which I paid via Net Banking. During counseling, they promised a premium batch with a 1:35 teacher-student ratio and senior IITian faculty. However, when classes started on August 1, they merged 4 batches together into a massive auditorium with over 190 students, and the mathematics faculty was abruptly replaced by an inexperienced college graduate who read off PowerPoint slides. My son could neither ask doubts nor follow the lessons. On August 16 (after only 15 days of attendance), I submitted a formal written application requesting course discontinuation and pro-rata refund of the unutilized 11.5 months fees (approx ₹1,25,000). The center director rejected the application, pointing to a small clause at the bottom of the fee receipt: 'Fees once paid is non-negotiable and strictly non-refundable under any circumstances whatsoever.' I have the fee receipt, bank transaction statement, the written withdrawal application with stamped receipt acknowledgment, and photos of the overcrowded 190-student lecture hall.
